title: Chrono SMP Official Modpack
description: A modpack for a you and your friends to have a fun chill time in
body:
Welcome to Chrono SMP, the ultimate Minecraft modpack built for laid-back fun with friends. Whether you're sipping tea in a cottage by the lake, fishing at sunset, or going on light-hearted adventures through beautiful biomes, Chrono SMP is all about good vibes, exploration, and creative expression.

This modpack keeps things simple but rich: lush world generation, gentle ambient sounds, easy farming, cooking, and building tools that make collaboration and relaxation the focus. No high-stress combat or complex tech—just you, your friends, and a peaceful world to make your own.

🛏️ Features:
Cozy home-building tools and decor mods

Simple farming and cooking for wholesome roleplay

Chill quests and light exploration for casual progression

Multiplayer-friendly features like shared storage and emotes

Perfect for small SMPs, hangouts, or low-pressure survival worlds. Kick back, build a village, plant some crops, and enjoy Minecraft at your own pace.

Take a breath. Place a block. Laugh with friends. That’s Chrono SMP.
